module.title: Frontend View Contracts and Read Models
module.business_purpose: Provides frontend-ready, permission-aware read contracts. Every page binds to a route, a versioned read model, field metadata, filters, sorting, actions, KPIs and explicit loading/empty/error/forbidden/stale states. Views return display-ready labels and stable codes without exposing ORM models, secrets or unnecessary PHI.
